scripts.install:all: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
scripts.dev:backend: cd app/backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck:backend: cd app/backend && uv run python -m compileall app tests
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: cd app/backend && uv run ruff check .
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.build:backend: cd app/backend && uv run python -m compileall app
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.docker:config: docker compose config && docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.remote.yml config
